name: Ózd (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the town arms of Ózd (a crowned shield of red, white, green and blue with crossed hammers, with blue and red mantling) above the name ÓZD in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Ózd arms with crown and mantling
